sentences.en: Like, what, what, what?
sentences.zh: 就像是，什么，什么，什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, okay.
sentences.zh: 好啊，没问题。

sentences.en: And he totally agreed.
sentences.zh: 他完全同意了。

sentences.zh: 当我们向媒体宣布威尔的戏份时，我们发布了新闻稿。

sentences.en: Paul Lieberstein, who was the showrunner at the time, had this very funny quote.

sentences.zh: 我们很自豪能延续《办公室》发掘知名人才的传统，希望有一天美国观众能好好认识一下威尔·法瑞尔。

sentences.zh: 好了，第二个速记事实来自加州阿普兰的伯尼斯·C的粉丝提问。

sentences.zh: 不，那是不可能的。

sentences.en: And we all knew that.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都知道这一点。

sentences.zh: 能请到他我们已经很幸运了。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: We actually asked Greg Daniels about Will joining the show, and here's what he had to say.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上问过格雷格·丹尼尔斯关于威尔加入剧组的事，他是这样说的。

sentences.en: I think there was a feeling of, can the show survive without Steve?
sentences.zh: 我想当时大家都在想，没有了史蒂夫，这部剧还能撑下去吗？

sentences.en: And everybody wanted it to.
sentences.zh: 每个人都希望它能撑下去。

sentences.en: We all felt like there was so much vitality in the ensemble caSt.
sentences.zh: 我们都觉得整个演员阵容依然充满活力。

sentences.en: There were more stories to tell.
sentences.zh: 还有很多故事可以讲。

sentences.en: Steve did not want to kill the show with his exit.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫不想因为他的离开而终结这部剧。

sentences.en: And so there was this feeling of, don't save his exit to the very, very end of the season,
sentences.zh: 所以当时有一种感觉，就是不要把他的离开留到这一季的最后时刻，

sentences.en: and then have all summer for fans to be like, well, I'm done.
sentences.zh: 然后让粉丝们整个夏天都在想，好吧，我弃剧了。

sentences.zh: 所以威尔·法瑞尔就是那个甜头。

sentences.zh: 我们都很高兴能请到威尔·法瑞尔，而且他和史蒂夫私交很好。

sentences.en: And it seemed like, you know, something that signaled to people, like, life would go on.

sentences.en: There would be exciting, you know, other comedy people that we could bring in.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以请到其他令人兴奋的喜剧演员。

sentences.en: And it also took a little pressure off, probably.
sentences.zh: 而且这可能也减轻了一些压力。

sentences.en: Like, whoever would have been the next boss right after Steve, it would have been very difficult, probably.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，无论谁接替史蒂夫成为下一任老板，可能都会非常困难。

sentences.en: It was good to have a little palate cleanser in there.

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: When are we going to get an A from Miles is what I want to know.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我们什么时候才能从迈尔斯那里得到一个A。

sentences.en: Maybe never.
sentences.zh: 也许永远不会。

sentences.en: Is it going to take?
sentences.zh: 这需要多久？

sentences.en: Is it going to be Michael's last dundies?
sentences.zh: 这会是迈克尔最后一次邓迪奖颁奖礼吗？

sentences.en: Is it going to be goodbye, Michael?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这是要告别了吗？

sentences.en: I'll let you know.
sentences.zh: 我会让你知道的。

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 走着瞧吧。

sentences.en: I can't wait to hear.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想听听结果了。

sentences.en: Well, a big thank you to Randy Cordray, Ellie Kemper, and Ed Helms
sentences.zh: 非常感谢兰迪·科德雷、艾丽·坎伯和艾德·赫尔姆斯

sentences.en: for giving us some nice little tidbits for this episode.
sentences.zh: 为本集节目提供了一些精彩的小花絮。

sentences.en: And if you have the DVD, go watch the extended cut.
sentences.zh: 如果你有DVD，一定要去看看加长版。

sentences.en: There's a lot of fun stuff in there.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多有趣的内容。

sentences.zh: 下周我们将回归，带来迈克尔的最后一次邓迪奖颁奖礼。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh, I can't believe it.
